description: This file contains locale-specific culture information and date parsing/formatting functions for Hungarian (Hungary) as part of the DateJS library. It defines culture-specific data such as day names, month names, date formats, regex patterns for parsing dates, and various date manipulation methods.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds of the date object to zero.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date object to the current local time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares the date object to another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of a day given its name.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of a month given its name.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a given month of a specific year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns the timezone abbreviation for a given offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset for a timezone name.

methods.name: moveToFirstDayOfMonth
methods.description: Moves the date to the first day of its month.

methods.name: moveToLastDayOfMonth
methods.description: Moves the date to the last day of its month.

methods.name: moveToNthOccurrence
methods.description: Moves the date to the nth occurrence of a specified day of the week.

methods.name: moveToDayOfWeek
methods.description: Moves the date to a specific day of the week.

methods.name: getISOWeek
methods.description: Returns the ISO week number based on UTC.

methods.name: setWeek
methods.description: Sets the date to a specific week number.

methods.name: toISOString
methods.description: Returns the ISO string representation of the date.
